audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said Irelia owned Levels 1-5 and 'Skill' owned 6+, while the content layer win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Katarina for all seven rows, and every phases[N].why describes Katarina winning that stage.
audit.why: Cross-layer disagreement: the row header contradicted the sentence under it and the other file. Win rate is 52.5% over 3440 games in Katarina's favour, and the whys are already written from the Katarina-ahead side.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to Katarina, matching win[0..6] (already Katarina on disk) and the packet chart. Whys left untouched because they already argue the Katarina side.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: level 3 full dagger rotation, level 6 Death Lotus, first item burst before her Blade of the Ruined King, late-game reset scaling. Irelia's counter-spikes are Vanguard's Edge at 6 (125s at rank 1) and max Ionian Fervor stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all and named no real cooldown, and dosFull/dontsFull bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: The decisive interaction here is Flawless Duet (E, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) stunning Katarina out of the Death Lotus channel — the kit lists R as 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. The second interaction is Bladesurge (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s) refreshing on a Marked or dying target, so a low-HP minion beside you is her gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now states Flawless Duet 16s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5, Bladesurge 10s with its reset condition, and Vanguard's Edge 125s at rank 1. Do's and Don'ts bodies rewritten to match their own titles.

audit.why: Vanguard's Edge only disarms enemies passing through the wall, so being already inside it at cast makes it irrelevant — already stated in spikes[1] and mid.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield or Blade + pots. Stormsurge or Nashor-AP lines, Sorcerer's, then Zhonya's-Rabadon's. Build for the reset, not the poke. Death Lotus already applies anti-heal to her Bladesurge.

edits.before: Commit on Flawless Duet (Stun)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Flawless Duet's 16s downtime, on your first item spike, and with your jungler's setup. Make her spend E first.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shunpo (second use) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (Stun) is 16s at rank 1 and still 10s at rank 5 — the whole matchup lives in that gap, because it is what stuns you out of Death Lotus. - Bladesurge is 10s but refreshes on a Marked or dying target, so never trade beside a low minion. - Vanguard's Edge is 125s at rank 1.

edits.before: Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Bouncing Blade reaches 625 and costs no mana — chip her off the wave from outside her 600-range Q.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Sinister Steel's burst of Move Speed, up every 15s at rank 1, buys the step out of her Bladesurge.

edits.before: Irelia spends Flawless Duet (Stun) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Any jungler CC buys a full string plus Lotus — with her E spent she has no way to cancel it.

edits.before: That’s Irelia’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Flawless Duet stuns you out of the channel — hold Lotus until that E is spent.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: With no dagger down and Shunpo on its 12s rank-1 cooldown you have no exit — she Bladesurges and you die where you landed.

edits.before: Irelia wins by landing Flawless Duet (Stun), denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Irelia wins by holding Flawless Duet for your Death Lotus, stunning you mid-channel, and healing the trade back through Bladesurge resets on low minions.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Irelia off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, starve the resets: she needs low minions for Bladesurge, so keep the wave thin, punish her step-ups, and roam on her recalls.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by entering second: let her Bladesurge into your team, then Shunpo the dying target and chain the resets out.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: thin and pushed with no low-HP minions left for Bladesurge to reset on — she cannot cross 600 range without one. Worst wave: a big slow push beside her, which is a free Q-chain straight onto your face. Crash timing: crash while Flawless Duet is down, then take the roam rather than the extra CS.
